description: DOMPurify - a DOM-only, super-fast, uber-tolerant XSS sanitizer for HTML, MathML and SVG. DOMPurify works with a secure default, but offers a lot of configurability and hooks. Demo:

latest_release.name: DOMPurify 3.4.17
latest_release.body:
* Fixed an issue with `IN_PLACE`, `SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES` and shadow roots, thanks @manus-pi
* Fixed `IN_PLACE` handling of nodes that hooks or custom elements tough during sanitization, thanks @uttej-badwane
* Fixed the SMIL `attributeName` guard in XHTML mode, thanks @Koukyosyumei
* Hardened several smaller edge cases (namespaces, literal-text elements, `isValidAttribute()`), thanks @artiphishell
* Added a purify-edge test runner as a compatibility check, thanks @anzal1
* Clarified the `IN_PLACE` documentation in the README about possible risks
* Updated several dependencies
